_about: The I-360 (Special Immigrant Juvenile) petition packet (src/packet.py, src/i360.py): the step before the I-485. The firm's G-28 for the petition and the I-360 on top, then the evidence USCIS asks for: the state court order with SIJ findings (required) and proof of age (the birth certificate, required), then identity and entry documents. Built into its own files (packet_i360.pdf, packet_i360.json), so it never replaces the I-485 packet. The attorney approves titles and order.
title: I-360 petition (Special Immigrant Juvenile)
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

exhibits.title: State court order with Special Immigrant Juvenile findings (certified copy)
Birth certificate, with certified English translation (proof of age)
Passport identity page and any U.S. visa
Immigration court documents (Notice to Appear, orders)
